Olympic Games
The origin of the ancient Olympic Games is lost in the midst of
pre-L ~history; but for many centuries they were only festival of the Greek
People; The Games were first held in honour of the Greek god, Zeus in 776
BC in the plain of the kingdom of Elis, nestled in a lush valley between
the Alpheus River and Mount Kronion; 15 km from the Ionian Sea. The
Olympiad celebrated that year was considered as the first and was used to
date ' 'subsequent historic events. But religious ceremonies and games were
held = Olympia before that time The oldest sanctuary of Greece was there,
